meta.title: Events — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Meetups, demos and launches of the OpenAEC Foundation. First up: the OpenAEC Launch Day on Tuesday 15 December 2026 in Dordrecht, the Netherlands.

header.label: OpenAEC Foundation
header.desc: Meetups, demos and launches of the OpenAEC Foundation. Come along, see the software working live and talk to the people who build it.

launch.desc: The official launch of the OpenAEC Foundation. An afternoon of live demos of open-source software for construction, a panel with decision-makers from the industry and the moment the foundation gets under way. Followed by a walking dinner. Free, registration required.

note: More events will follow. Want to stay informed? Follow us on LinkedIn or read the news.
